svg.text: ppiBTEP: Bi-directional Transformer Embedding Pairs for PPI Classification
Adapts ESM-1b (Rives et al., 2021) via Siamese (twin-branch) architecture
Key Insight: Unlike ppiDCE's cross-encoding, ppiBTEP processes each
protein INDEPENDENTLY through a SHARED ESM encoder. No cross-sequence
attention -- interaction features must be captured within each protein's
| M K T I L E ... | | M S E Q R A ... |
| ONE input, JOINT | | Branch A | | Branch B |
- Siamese: independent encoding, faster, protein representations reusable
| ESM encode A ESM encode B |
